flags.item: Market lines have no documented source
flags.detail: nfldata documents spread_line and total_line but names no upstream source. Gate G0 fails for every strategy.

flags.item: Our model is less accurate than the market
flags.detail: Walk-forward 2016–2025: model MAE 10.17 points vs market spread 9.79 points.

flags.item: Starting-QB injury strategies cannot be tested
flags.detail: Only 7 games in 2016–2025 with a starting QB Out or Doubtful on the official report.
No official source publishes historical prop prices.

flags.item: Singapore: participation in unlicensed remote gambling is an offence
flags.detail: Only Singapore Pools is licensed for remote gambling. This site is for analysis only and does not recommend any wager.

flags.item: Depth charts are third-party and not week-keyed
flags.detail: Latest ESPN-derived snapshot only; the Week 10 result (2 starters out with named backups) needs checking against team depth charts.

flags.item: Only 3 of 137 final 2026 games checked against nfl.com
flags.detail: Spot checks matched. The remaining 134 final games are unverified.

flags.item: nfldata archive has no LICENSE file
flags.detail: Reuse terms for the data and code are unknown.

flags.item: Unplayed 2026 games carry third-party market lines in the data file
flags.detail: Not shown on the site; the market columns are blank.

flags.item: Injury file: 9 of 1,230 rows checked against the official page
flags.detail: The Week 10 rows that were checked matched; the rest are not verified row by row.

flags.item: Mirror files cannot be downloaded from the sandbox
flags.detail: Release assets only download inside GitHub Actions. Reproducibility depends on CI.

flags.item: Team codes: 2026 injury and depth files use the same 32 codes
flags.detail: Checked: both files use LA, LV, LAC and the other 29 codes. Historical team-code changes in the 2016–2025 injury data were not checked.

flags.item: Kerby Joseph (DET, S), Week 10: report status and practice status conflict
flags.detail: Our 2026 injury file lists Kerby Joseph as Out for Week 10 with practice status 'Full Participation in Practice' (Knee). Out and full practice participation is inconsistent and is not resolved. Only the first games of the fetched Week 10 page were compared; this row is not confirmed against the official page. Week 10 comparison is incomplete: 9 rows checked of 1,230 in the file.

flags.item: NFL.com systematic-retrieval rights are not documented
flags.detail: NFL.com Terms §1.3 limits Services use to individual, non-commercial, informational purposes and prohibits systematic retrieval to build a collection or database absent express prior written consent. No project permission record was found. This is a source-rights warning, not a legal conclusion that permission does not exist. Review the Terms and obtain appropriate written authorization before enabling any new NFL.com data acquisition or expanding an automated fetcher.
